item.text: {"topic_id":"132","confidence":1,"reasoning":"This tests computing probability by counting combinations: choose 2 of 7 boys and 3 of 5 girls, then divide by the number of ways to choose 5 of 12 players. The probability is C(7,2)C(5,3)/C(12,5)=210/792≈27%, matching Computing Probabilities Using Combinatorics."}
